scope: N703 eight-flow release identity, replacement/retirement, rollback and preservation receipt design; source-bound read-only CPU review. No implementation, tests, native installers, launch, network, GPU, canonical/catalog/source edits or runtime acceptance.

proposal_public_receipt_json_schema.title: UNAPPROVED proposed N703 public receipt
proposal_public_receipt_json_schema.description: A proposed shape only. Structural validity is not runtime acceptance; the semantic rules in this proposal are mandatory for any future approved implementation.

data.description: Discriminated private data definitions below are proposed; Home must finalize exact platform forms. Never include credentials.

required_typed_fields.spacr_module_path: absolute path string or bounded frozen module identity
required_typed_fields.distribution_path: absolute path string or null for explicitly supported frozen case
required_typed_fields.code_inventory: array of package-relative path, kind, bytes, sha256, link target; actual file identity checked before/after hashing
required_typed_fields.version_observations: private raw/normalized string, method, provenance, parse status and reason for any public null/redaction; private build labels are never copied publicly
required_typed_fields.process_identity: platform PID/start-token (private); UID only if required privately

required_typed_fields.window_identity: native window-to-process association, expected application identity, visible bool
required_typed_fields.observer_scope: controlled native observation or synthetic; no invented human signoff
required_typed_fields.startup_errors: private bounded redacted diagnostic; no full restart-state dump

required_typed_fields.quiescence: proof of no participating writes, or explicit unresolved status
required_typed_fields.entries: relative path; kind=file|directory|symlink|junction; size integer; file content SHA256 or null; link target private; optional mode/owner identity; errors array
required_typed_fields.tree_digest: sha256 of declared canonical entry encoding with schema/ordering included
required_typed_fields.unreadable_or_excluded: explicit array with reason; never silently omit

required_typed_fields.active_staged_backup_identities: role paths/dev-inode or platform equivalent, code/tree hash
required_typed_fields.event: public state plus exact source operation and monotonic clock epoch

required_typed_fields.exact_objects: local path identity, inventorySHA, category, displayed count/bytes, action
required_typed_fields.consent_origin: default-off GUI selection; no ambient installer-root permission
required_typed_fields.removed_objects: exact bound objectIDs with per-object outcome

required_typed_fields.conflicts_retained: local object IDs and reason; no overwrite claim

mandatory_semantic_rules.rule: The installation success outcomes installed_requested, same_version_repaired and newer_retained require native_runtime_observation, native platform matching flow, ready_verified GUI with all four binding/window/event-loop booleans true and controlled_native_receipt, actual_gui_process selected identity, verified runtime/import bindings, required native payload checks, complete preservation and correct retirement. rolled_back is a recovery outcome requiring rollback.restored_gui and verified previous identity/data; it never accepts the new release. Static/synthetic receipts describe tests only, never native installation acceptance.

installed_requested: approved normalization parses and effective GUI version equals nonnull requested; fresh version observations agree under the policy and required expected artifact/code identities are verified. For mode upgrade, requested/effective must be greater than a verified previous version. If previous is greater, retain it under newer_retained or refuse; never downgrade. Null previous is permitted only for explicitly inventoried fresh_install with no previous selected application, not as an upgrade loophole. Same version routes same_version_repair. Metadata equality alone is insufficient; absent expected inventory or unknown/unparseable/private-only public versions cannot certify native installation.

same_version_repaired requires explicit same_version_repair selection, a verified previous baseline and effective == requested == previous under the approved policy, with repair payload/code integrity verified. Do not pass repair through a >previous rule or claim it was an upgrade.

newer_retained requires previous GUI/code baseline >requested under the approved policy; selected effective remains that same verified newer version/code/runtime, no downgrade or replacement was done, and the retained GUI launches through the intended native route. Record requested and effective separately; do not label requested version installed. Current N627 uses bounded numeric release comparison; no claim of arbitrary PEP440 support there.

Each GUI attempt uses a fresh opaque one-use challenge and bounded deadline; record challenge-consumption result, not the raw challenge, publicly. Bind selected process start identity, actual imported code and independent native window association. Old PID, reused receipt, wrong launch route, helper-ready or isolated probe cannot satisfy it. Challenge correlation is not cryptographic attestation against a compromised application.

Installer/helper exit codes remain independent of final outcome. exit0 only means that process returned0. Spawned PID or LaunchServices acceptance only means launch requested. It cannot prove requested version, actual imports, new GUI readiness, rollback or user-data preservation.

Runtime proof privately records lexical executable path, resolved executable identity, sys.prefix/base_prefix, module/distribution locations and launcher target. A legitimate venv executable may resolve to a shared base interpreter outside prefix; verify approved executable+prefix+import bindings rather than requiring resolved Python below sys.prefix. For frozen builds bind bundle/executable/code inventory and native version/signature/architecture instead of assuming ordinary site-packages.

All evidence IDs resolve to immutable same-attempt local observations; redacted public files have hash/length bindings. State sequence strictly increases and elapsed monotonic time never decreases within the same collector lifetime. UTC alone does not prove order. Freshness/nonce limits are implementation parameters that must be declared, never invented retrospectively.

Preservation requires a complete declared scope covering default and custom caches, models, test data, user settings, projects/outputs, unknown install children and backups. Inventory before and after while quiesced; record file content SHA256, tree membership and symlink/junction targets privately, including failures. Concurrent writes/unreadable entries/missing baseline mean incomplete, not unchanged. No broad 2341-crop/NAS scanning is requested by this proposal.

Explicit cleanup is default-off and separately consented by exact eligible object identity, displayed contents/count/bytes and chosen action. Recheck identity immediately before deletion; changed path/link/contents requires refusal or renewed review. A directory being under an installer root does not authorize deleting models/data/unknown children. Preservation excludes only exact selected removals, which must be counted and bound.

Successful rollback requires actual previous code/runtime/launch point identity and a fresh previous native GUI observation plus data preservation; journal restoration or a surviving folder alone is not restored_verified. Failed or conflicting rollback keeps recovery artifacts and reports recovery_required/conflict_preserved. Do not destroy unknown changes or backup content to force a green result.

Complete retirement means active application launch targets reference the selected runtime and unrelated installations remain. A clearly labelled inactive recovery backup may retain old application bytes. A retained backup is not itself a stale active application. Cleanup refusal/failure and upgrade result are recorded separately without concealing either.

Public version fields contain only the bounded normalized released-version grammar in this proposal or null; no raw observations, local/private suffixes or arbitrary error text. Public policy IDs are bounded enumerations describing a proposed comparator, not Home schema approval. Raw versions and parse/redaction reasons remain private; unparseable/private-only identities cannot be marked verified success. If Home approves a broader release syntax later, amend the public contract explicitly instead of silently publishing raw strings.

proposed_transition_routes.condition: No destructive retirement of the old working app before staged verification and a recoverable activation plan. Existing early cleanup is a gap, not evidence of this future ordering.
Verify unchanged higher existing code and intended GUI; no staging/install/old-active retirement.
May terminate earlier. old_retained_verified needs actual baseline identity/GUI, otherwise old_retained_unverified.
Any identity/GUI/retirement/preservation failure requires bounded recovery; unsuccessful or conflicting recovery ends recovery_required.
unsupported is a separate terminal state for unsupported adapter. Cancellation after activation follows recovery, not pre-commit cancelled-old-retained.

current_journal_mapping.prepared: Staging/recoverable exchange prepared, not native GUI readiness. Preserve original source journal states without relabelling them.
current_journal_mapping.committed: Frozen bundle exchange and identity verified. Map to activated_unverified until a separate actual-GUI observation arrives; existing committed receipts remain historically valid for their declared scope.
current_journal_mapping.rolled_back_or_recovered: Source recovery operation may restore identities; only complete previous runtime+GUI+data evidence can establish proposed rolled_back_verified.
current_journal_mapping.handshake_ready: Helper preparation/old-app shutdown coordination. Never new GUI acknowledgement.

field_to_current_source_and_test_seams.observable: Record requested version separately from effective code. Fresh isolated probe is corroboration; actual GUI process supplies sys.executable, sys.prefix/base_prefix, package and module locations, package/application versions and approved code-inventory identity. Private resolved/lexical identities are checked against the selected runtime and payload.
field_to_current_source_and_test_seams.current_limit: Version metadata can disagree with imported code. Mac online uses unpinned uv upgrade plus numeric 3/4-part probe >=offered and >previous; it does not prove installed exact request or same-version repair. Expected payload inventory and actual GUI identity require future implementation.

field_to_current_source_and_test_seams.observable: Launch via the route under test; bind one-use bounded challenge to the new selected GUI process, main window and event-loop response. Independently record the native window/process association; a hidden/offscreen or mocked process is explicitly synthetic, not native GUI acceptance.
field_to_current_source_and_test_seams.current_limit: Detached PID, LaunchServices accepted request, installer exit0 and _FrozenUpdateHandshake.ready do not show the new GUI started. Handshake.ready is helper preparation before old-app shutdown. Existing restart state contains private GUI settings/folders, not public launch proof.

field_to_current_source_and_test_seams.observable: Bind before/staged/active/backup directory and code identities, complete durable journal transitions and failpoints. Restore previous active code and native GUI after failed activation; retain conflicting content rather than overwrite.
field_to_current_source_and_test_seams.current_limit: Frozen Mac has prepared/committed/recovery journal and actual-directory rollback. Its committed journal means exchange verified, not GUI verified. Generic root cleanup can precede staging. Windows catch does not restore an already deleted old root; keeping venv-previous later does not prove rollback across earlier cleanup.

field_to_current_source_and_test_seams.observable: Inventory protected/custom/unknown objects before mutation and again after success or recovery, while writers are quiesced. Match file/tree content, symlink or junction targets, ownership/permission identity as applicable, and selected deletion list. Prove active launch targets now resolve selected runtime while backup and unrelated installs remain.
field_to_current_source_and_test_seams.current_limit: Known user-data/HF/XDG paths nested inside an install root currently cause whole-root refusal; omitted custom model/backend/cache roots and unknown children can still be deleted. Online launcher is absolute only with absolute inputs; frozen desktop PATH resolution is not observed by source reads.

privacy_and_publication_rules: Public receipt is allowlisted, uses opaque random IDs and normalized runtime roles; never raw user paths, usernames/hostnames/account IDs, emails, device serials, arbitrary environment values, command lines, raw data filenames/settings, restart-state contents, tokens, private keys or credentials.

Local path/process/inventory detail stays in a protected private evidence store; private receipts must not contain secrets either. Publish only hashes/lengths of sanitized public evidence. Do not publish individual user-data content hashes or deterministic hashes of low-entropy raw paths as a substitute for redaction.

Public aggregate preservation claims refer to retained private evidence IDs; they are not independently reproducible from public receipt alone. Authorized local review can check private inventories and source bindings. Public code/artifact hashes are suitable when they identify nonprivate release payloads.

Validate before publication with additionalProperties=false allowlists and typed fields; reject unexpected strings/fields rather than dump raw errors. Reviewer scope, synthetic/native and unknown/unverified values must survive sanitization.

No new signing service/key collection is prescribed. Hashes bind recorded bytes; they do not alone attest observer truth, author authorization, physical GUI visibility or absence of a compromised application.
future_targeted_negative_scenarios: Installer exit0 but metadata/imported GUI old version; installer metadata fresh while actual GUI imports stale module.
Wrong interpreter/prefix or environment/PATH module shadow; legitimate venv base-Python symlink remains allowed when prefix/import identities match.
Old-process/reused challenge receipt, wrong window/process, launch accepted but no window, GUI event-loop timeout; all remain incomplete/failed.
N627 higher existing runtime preserved: newer_retained with effective higher version; same-version repair is distinct; unparseable version refuses successful comparison.
Failure before stage verification or after active exchange; prove old GUI and code restored, or honest recovery_required. Preserve changed/conflicting backup content.
Known protected path nested in install root causes current refusal; custom model/cache/backend roots and unknown files remain inventoried/preserved by future implementation.
Default-off cleanup none, exact explicit selection, changed symlink/junction before deletion, unreadable inventory and concurrent writers cannot produce unchanged verdict.
Standard and relative launcher overrides/frozen desktop PATH: actual route selects exact runtime or fails. Unrelated Python environments and inactive recovery backup remain.
Public receipt exporter rejects raw user paths/settings/keys/PII and strips no evidence-scope qualification.
implementation_gaps_and_nonclaims: JSON shape is proposed, not an approved schema or runnable validator. Cross-field version, graph, freshness, filesystem and native-observation checks need an owning implementation; schema validity alone never grants success.
No existing eight-flow native acceptance is inferred from mocked tests, static hashes or this proposal. Proposed GUI acknowledgement/observer and private inventories are not implemented here.

Current Windows early cleanup and generic root replacement ordering need correction before staged/rollback guarantees. Current frozen Windows/Linux-deb in-app adapter refusals remain unsupported until specific adapters are implemented.
Home owns source implementation and version-policy acceptance; source freeze remains. No installer/env/package/test/app/catalog/canonical publication changes were made.
state_graph_semantics: Routes above are illustrations; adjacency and outcome mapping are the proposed exact graph. Mode and evidence predicates still apply: complete_newer_retained only on retain-newer route; successful repair/fresh-install/upgrade require their declared baseline rules. An interrupted nonterminal observation is incomplete. Do not rewrite existing source journal states or historical receipt meanings to pretend this graph was implemented.

changes: Remove raw public version field; bound public normalized versions and policy IDs.
Separate successful rollback recovery from installed-release acceptance.
Add exact proposed state adjacency and terminal outcome mapping.
